summary: Zoo Tycoon entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Zoo Tycoon 2
entries.definitive_edition: Zoo Tycoon 2: Ultimate Collection on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use Windows compatibility settings or a VM only if necessary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC Ultimate Collection with all expansions installed

primary.why: The Windows Ultimate Collection is the completeness route because it includes the base game and the four main expansion packs. Mac and DS routes are not equivalent substitutes, and current access depends on old retail media or verified legal ownership.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Ultimate Collection. Record disc/source, patch state, installed expansions, resolution/widescreen fix state, compatibility settings, OS, custom content/mods, and scenario/freeform progress.

secondary.why: The Mac route does not represent the full Ultimate Collection expansion set.

secondary.what_to_play: Document separately if covering handheld spinoffs.
secondary.why: It is not a substitute for the PC simulation route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record source media and compatibility fixes. Do not substitute the 2013 Zoo Tycoon/Ultimate Animal Collection reboot for Zoo Tycoon 2.

entries.title: Zoo Tycoon
entries.definitive_edition: Zoo Tycoon: Complete Collection on PC with expansion/custom-content state documented

emulation.notes: Native old Windows route preferred; document compatibility fixes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Complete Collection PC install with exact expansion/save/mod state documented

primary.version: Zoo Tycoon: Complete Collection from original discs where available
primary.why: The 2001 Zoo Tycoon route is best represented by Complete Collection because it includes the base game plus the Dinosaur Digs and Marine Mania expansion content. It is not the same as the 2013 Zoo Tycoon or Ultimate Animal Collection reboot/port.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PC copy, preferably Complete Collection. Record disc/source, patch/version, expansions installed, scenario/freeform zoo, save, custom content/mods, OS compatibility fixes, resolution, and whether later Zoo Tycoon 2013/Ultimate Animal Collection were excluded.

secondary.platform: Zoo Tycoon DS / 2013 Zoo Tycoon / Ultimate Animal Collection
secondary.why: They are not the 2001 PC game route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Zoo Tycoon 2, Zoo Tycoon 2013, or Ultimate Animal Collection.
